title: Reminder mail: in-process timer, claim-before-send ledger, pinned SMTP library
context: Reminders and expired parks only reached the operator through the Inbox count while a tab was open. The operator chose mail as the second channel: off by default, one mail per item per day, parks once, password in .env.local.
decision: A server check at start and on a schedule reads due for all projects via the W1 bridge, claims each ledger key under a lock BEFORE sending, mails escaped plain text, and records failures (max 3 tries per item and day). nodemailer 10.6.1 is the only new dependency.
consequences: FR-01.77 minted. At-most-once on a crash between claim and SMTP answer (mail stays in the Inbox). STARTTLS is required off loopback. New dependency enters the build graph. A damaged ledger fails closed.
rationale: Smallest option that meets the operator decisions: in-process timer plus one small file, a maintained SMTP library instead of owning TLS and auth, the secret in the central user folder outside every repo, write-only in the API.
rejected: Separate OS scheduled job; browser-only notifications; hand-written SMTP client; at-least-once send-then-record (repeats mails after a crash); plain SMTP override.
